# Peridot Markets

> SuperMarkets (formerly Peridot Markets) gives any Stellar token everything it needs under one roof: launch it, lend and borrow it, earn yield on it and trade it with leverage, from one app on Stellar (Soroban). Every token gets its own isolated lending market with a safe price oracle, so one market's failure never reaches another. Tokens launched on the Aquarius-only launchpad can graduate into a real lending market. Built for HackMeridian 2026 on top of the audited Peridot lending core (timelocks set to 60 seconds for the event). Beta: the new contracts are unaudited.

## Live app
- [Mainnet app](https://markets.peridot.finance/): markets, groups, vaults, launchpad (connected to Stellar mainnet, beta).
- [Testnet app](https://test-markets.peridot.finance/): same app on Stellar testnet with free test tokens (switch networks with the pill in the header).
- [Launch a token](https://markets.peridot.finance/launch-token): simple token, bonding curve or ICO.
- [Token list](https://markets.peridot.finance/tokens)
- [Vaults](https://markets.peridot.finance/vaults): Aquarius ladder, Blend, DeFindex, XOXNO and Zenex vault options created from a vault factory.
- [About, prior work and architecture](https://markets.peridot.finance/about)

## Key facts
- Network: Stellar Soroban, contracts written in Rust (soroban-sdk 25.3).
- Isolated market groups deployed by a factory (deploy_v2); one bad token cannot endanger other groups.
- Price sources: Reflector, or Aquarius pool pricing with a step guard for launchpad tokens.
- Yield routes: Blend fee vault, DeFindex, Aquarius LP ladder vault, XOXNO, Zenex.
- Leverage: owner-enabled per token, staged parameter changes with a 60 second timelock.
- Launchpad: Aquarius-only; graduation locks liquidity and opens a lending market.
- Wallets: Stellar Wallets Kit (Albedo, Freighter, xBull, LOBSTR, Hana).
